action_item: Define financial goals for the venture
Define target cash flow per property
Decide self-managed ownership vs. co-hosting/management-company model
Decide vacation/leisure market vs. urban/business-travel market
Define each partner's role and responsibilities
Define a future capital call process (e.g., unplanned $15K roof repair in year two)
Define a partner compensation structure (what happens if one partner does more of the actual work?)
Draft and sign the operating/partnership agreement with an attorney
Decide entity structure: single LLC vs. holding-company-plus-property-level-LLC
Set up bookkeeping and accounting software
Set up a partner reporting cadence
Establish a CPA relationship and STR tax strategy
Research airport/drive-time access for your target guest
Build a market comparison spreadsheet against your thresholds
Build a realtor network across shortlisted markets
Learn to read AirDNA-style market data
Learn dynamic-pricing concepts (before you need them live)
Decide if you're open to fixer-uppers
Decide if you're open to land + new-build
Decide if you're targeting turnkey only
Decide if you're targeting a unique/statement-stay niche vs. standard rental
Project revenue (occupancy × ADR × seasonality) per candidate
Underwrite internet/connectivity — verify actual availability and speed, not just "listed"
Set minimum return thresholds before you're emotionally attached to a property
Compare financing products (DSCR, 2nd-home conventional, investment loan)
Decide down payment structure and funding source
Negotiate price, terms, and seller concessions
Review inspection reports, renegotiate if needed
Get a survey if boundaries are unclear
Translate concept into a design direction
Source smart-home devices (thermostat, noise monitor, water sensors)
Complete a full safety walkthrough before listing
Apply for the STR business license/permit
Confirm parking, occupancy, and noise ordinance rules
Confirm septic capacity limits on legal occupancy
Set reminders for permit renewal deadlines
Build a recurring check for regulatory changes
Set up dynamic pricing software (e.g., PriceLabs)
Sync booking calendar to cleaning/vendor calendar
Find and vet a cleaning company
Line up a true emergency/same-day cleaner
Find a snow removal vendor (if applicable)
Find a hot tub vendor (if applicable)
Find a local property manager/co-host as backup coverage
Build an emergency contact list before you need it
Get vendor scope and rates in writing
Manage and over-deliver on your first guest
Refine pricing based on early data
Refine messaging templates based on real guest questions
Plan a wildfire/natural-disaster evacuation and guest-notification protocol
Build an "I can't get there in time" contingency plan
Standardize furnishing approach and vendor list
Continue scaling per your Phase 0 portfolio goal
